plan: Reduce exposure to concentrated tech and leveraged ETFs.
Sell all semiconductor and most AI/Software names.
Trim income ETF (QQQI) to reduce concentration.
Buy new, high-quality long setups from scanner.
Hold broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) with caution.
Maintain a significant cash buffer for safety.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It aims for low drawdowns by significantly reducing leverage and concentrating on quality names and income. Expect slower growth compared to other modes.

plan: Reduce concentration in tech and eliminate leveraged ETFs.
Trim semiconductor and some AI/Software holdings.
Trim income ETF (QQQI) to manage concentration.
Add new, high-quality long setups from scanner.
Maintain a moderate cash buffer.
Balance broad index exposure with select growth names.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by blending growth and risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding promising scanner setups. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Concentrate on high-conviction tech and add leveraged ETFs.
Increase exposure to AI/Software and select leveraged semiconductor ETFs.
Add new, high-scoring long setups from the scanner.
Trim income ETF (QQQI) to manage concentration.
Maintain a small cash buffer.
Accept higher potential drawdowns for amplified gains.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It aims for maximum growth but carries significantly higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the impact of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Maximize allocation to income-generating ETFs like QQQI.
Eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta tech/semiconductor names.
Reduce broad index exposure to prioritize income.
Hold a significant cash buffer for stability.
Focus on consistent monthly distributions over growth.
Monitor NAV for potential capital depreciation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing capital preservation and steady income. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and volatile assets. While aiming for stability, NAV can still decline in market downturns.
